title: Directive bundle-size budgets
description: Budgets enforced by scripts/size-check.ts. Each entry names a built entry file; the enforced number is that file plus every emitted file it imports, gzipped together.

_README.description: Why these numbers are what they are, for whoever has to raise one.

_CONSUMERS_README.description: Why the consumer-fixture numbers are what they are.

consumers.description: Consumer-fixture budgets enforced by scripts/size-consumer.ts: small real apps bundled for production, gzipped.

fixture.description: Path to a fixture app, relative to the repo root.

gzBudget.description: Ceiling in bytes for the gzipped production bundle, at zlib's default level.

noCondition.description: Bundle without the production export condition, with only process.env.NODE_ENV defined. Guards the default build's dev-check fold.

forbidden.description: Dev-only text that must not appear in the production bundle.

path.description: Path to a built entry file, relative to the repo root. Name the entry, never a chunk-*.js — chunk names are content-hashed and change on the next build that touches anything.

gzBudget.description: Ceiling in bytes for the gzipped closure, at zlib's default level.
